_comment: Versioned gate config for `kern bench --check`. warm_load/query ceilings are generous multipliers over the 2026-10-19 measured baseline (warm load 174 ms, worst query 91 ms) so the gate fails on REGRESSIONS, never on machine noise. The speedup floor guards the persisted-store fast path. min_results fails a query that returns nothing (a wiring regression, not a latency). cli_ms_max gates the daemon-mode CLI commands (search/context/explore/impact on a leaf symbol, plus impact-hub on the index's heaviest TYPE — types aggregate methods+constructors, the worst impact shape; a leaf-only gate let real p95s regress invisibly). cli_cold_ms_max separately gates cold-cli mode, whose rows deliberately include process start and index hydration; its 2026-11-17 baseline on this repo was 262/279/795/1052/1317 ms. The daemon ceilings preserve the prior gate: search/context/explore/impact stay at 2x the 2026-10-27 SLO targets (150/250/300/400 ms — met through the warm daemon; KERN_DAEMON=0 reproduces the cold in-process path, which is now an explicitly labeled benchmark rather than a mixed-mode failure). impact-hub is a worst-shape probe, not an SLO: 2026-10-28 measured 981 ms after the impact attribution fixes (per-edge caller resolution memoized once per graph — internal/intel callerIndex — and the graphNodeFile node lookup made index-backed in tasklife; was 2293 ms when the report re-resolved every edge per root through a linear node scan), then 190 ms after campaign 3 (per-edge callee/caller incidence indexes replaced the per-root full-edge scans, and test-coverage tiering stopped materializing a per-root map plus per-root name tokenization). The daemon 400 ms ceiling ratchets just above that measurement so the gate fails on a return to the old 981 ms shape; the residual is the six per-root graph walks (dependents, direct dependents, services, APIs, events, tests — closure-memoized, structurally per-root) plus entity attachment. warn_factor 0.5 warns exactly at the target and fails at 2x. KERN_BENCH_THRESHOLDS points at an override file for testing. 2026-11-20 recalibration: cold-cli ceilings were raised to 1.3x the current measured medians on this repo because the repository and index grew enough that the older ceilings were no longer generous multipliers over the current shape; verify_reuse_speedup_min was lowered to 1.10 after the same repo growth reduced the fresh/reused ratio on the current command payload.
_comment_t07: T-07 campaign gates: classifier ceilings guard the guard fast path (fresh ~0.005 ms, cached ~0.0004 ms at 2026-11-19 — the 5/1 ms ceilings catch only real regressions like a cache that stopped hitting); verify_reuse_speedup_min 1.10 is the T-02 >=10% faster-reuse floor (measured 2.2x on a trivial command, so the floor is generous); repo_policy_bytes_max 2048 is the T-05 thin core block; global_policy_bytes_max 6144 the condensed global rules.
